retry_count, abandoned, safety_blocked_count, unauthorized_attempt_count, sensitive_output_hits, trace_id_source, computed_at ) VALUES ( #{m.traceId}, #{m.tenantId}::uuid, #{m.runId}::uuid, #{m.agentId}::uuid, #{m.agentVersion}, #{m.scenario}, #{m.modelId}, #{m.startedAt}, #{m.endedAt}, #{m.durationMs}, #{m.terminalState}, #{m.terminationReason}, #{m.inputTokens}, #{m.outputTokens}, #{m.costAmount}, #{m.currency}, #{m.toolRounds}, #{m.toolCallTotal}, #{m.toolCallFailed}, #{m.toolCallInvalid}, #{m.toolCallDuplicate}, #{m.loopSuspectedCount}, #{m.maxRoundsReached}, #{m.clarificationCount}, #{m.thinkMsTotal}, #{m.toolMsTotal}, #{m.autoChecked}, #{m.autoVerified}, #{m.sampled}, #{m.humanVerdict}, #{m.hallucination}, #{m.instructionFollowed}, #{m.feedbackUp}, #{m.feedbackDown}, #{m.retryCount}, #{m.abandoned}, #{m.safetyBlockedCount}, #{m.unauthorizedAttemptCount}, #{m.sensitiveOutputHits}, #{m.traceIdSource}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (trace_id) DO UPDATE SET tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, run_id = EXCLUDED.run_id, agent_id = EXCLUDED.agent_id, agent_version = EXCLUDED.agent_version, scenario = EXCLUDED.scenario, model_id = EXCLUDED.model_id, started_at = EXCLUDED.started_at, ended_at = EXCLUDED.ended_at, duration_ms = EXCLUDED.duration_ms, terminal_state = EXCLUDED.terminal_state, termination_reason = EXCLUDED.termination_reason, input_tokens = EXCLUDED.loop_suspected_count, max_rounds_reached = EXCLUDED.max_rounds_reached, clarification_count = EXCLUDED.clarification_count, think_ms_total = EXCLUDED.think_ms_total, tool_ms_total = EXCLUDED.tool_ms_total, computed_at = now()

INSERT INTO platform.agent_trace_tool_call (trace_id, tenant_id, tool_name, call_count, failed_count, invalid_count, duplicate_count, total_duration_ms, max_duration_ms, started_at) VALUES (#{r.traceId}, #{r.tenantId}::uuid, #{r.toolName}, #{r.callCount}, #{r.failedCount}, #{r.invalidCount}, #{r.duplicateCount}, #{r.totalDurationMs}, #{r.maxDurationMs}, #{r.startedAt})

INSERT INTO platform.agent_eval_sample (trace_id, tenant_id, verdict, hallucination, instruction_followed, attribution_correct, note, sampler) VALUES (#{r.traceId}, #{r.tenantId}::uuid, #{r.verdict}, #{r.hallucination}, #{r.instructionFollowed}, #{r.attributionCorrect}, #{r.note}, #{r.sampler})
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.agent_trace_metric SET sampled = TRUE, human_verdict = #{verdict}, hallucination = #{hallucination}, instruction_followed = #{instructionFollowed}, attribution_correct = #{attributionCorrect} WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid
UPDATE platform.agent_trace_metric SET attribution_correct = #{correct}, computed_at = now() WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform.agent_trace_feedback (trace_id, tenant_id, kind) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{kind})
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.agent_trace_metric SET feedback_up = coalesce(feedback_up, 0) + CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'THUMB_UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, feedback_down = coalesce(feedback_down, 0) + CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'THUMB_DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, retry_count = coalesce(retry_count, 0) + CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'RETRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform.agent_risk_event (trace_id, tenant_id, event_type, detail_digest) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{eventType}, #{detailDigest})
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.agent_trace_metric SET safety_blocked_count = coalesce(safety_blocked_count, 0) + CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'SAFETY_BLOCK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, unauthorized_attempt_count = coalesce(unauthorized_attempt_count, 0) + CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'UNAUTHORIZED_CALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sensitive_output_hits = coalesce(sensitive_output_hits, 0) + CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'SENSITIVE_OUTPUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform.agent_task_outcome (trace_id, tenant_id, checker_code, external_ref, verified, evidence_digest) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{checkerCode}, #{externalRef}, #{verified}, #{evidenceDigest}) ON CONFLICT (trace_id, checker_code) DO UPDATE SET verified = EXCLUDED.verified, external_ref = EXCLUDED.external_ref, evidence_digest = EXCLUDED.evidence_digest, checked_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.agent_trace_metric m SET auto_checked = TRUE, auto_verified = (SELECT bool_and(verified) FROM platform.agent_task_outcome WHERE trace_id = m.trace_id AND tenant_id = m.tenant_id) WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid
mapper.sql: trace_id AS traceId, tenant_id::text AS tenantId, run_id::text AS runId, agent_id::text AS agentId, agent_version AS agentVersion, scenario, model_id AS modelId, started_at AS startedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, duration_ms AS durationMs, terminal_state AS terminalState, termination_reason AS terminationReason, input_tokens AS inputTokens, output_tokens AS outputTokens, cost_amount AS costAmount, currency, tool_rounds AS toolRounds, tool_call_total AS toolCallTotal, tool_call_failed AS toolCallFailed, tool_call_invalid AS toolCallInvalid, tool_call_duplicate AS toolCallDuplicate, loop_suspected_count AS loopSuspectedCount, max_rounds_reached AS maxRoundsReached, clarification_count AS clarificationCount, think_ms_total AS thinkMsTotal, tool_ms_total AS toolMsTotal, auto_checked AS autoChecked, auto_verified AS autoVerified, sampled, human_verdict AS humanVerdict, hallucination, instruction_followed AS instructionFollowed, feedback_up AS feedbackUp, feedback_down AS feedbackDown, retry_count AS retryCount, abandoned, safety_blocked_count AS safetyBlockedCount, unauthorized_attempt_count AS unauthorizedAttemptCount, sensitive_output_hits AS sensitiveOutputHits, trace_id_source AS traceIdSource
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS traceCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE terminal_state = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succeeded, avg(duration_ms) AS avgDuration, sum(input_tokens) AS inTokens, sum(output_tokens) AS outTokens, sum(cost_amount) AS cost, avg(cost_amount) AS avgCost, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(input_tokens,0) + coalesce(output_tokens,0) > 20000) AS oversized, avg(tool_rounds) AS avgRounds, count(*) FILTER (WHERE max_rounds_reached) AS maxRounds, sum(tool_call_total) AS calls, sum(tool_call_invalid) AS invalid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE loop_suspected_count > 0) AS loops, count(auto_checked) AS autoChecked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_verified) AS autoVerified, count(sampled) AS sampled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE human_verdict = 'SUCCESS') AS humanOk, count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_verified AND sampled AND human_verdict <> 'SUCCESS') AS falseOk, count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_verified AND sampled) AS falseDenom, count(hallucination) FILTER (WHERE hallucination) AS hallucinated, count(*) FILTER (WHERE instruction_followed) AS followed, count(instruction_followed) AS followedDenom, count(attribution_correct) FILTER (WHERE attribution_correct) AS attrCorrect, count(attribution_correct) AS attrGraded, sum(feedback_up) AS fbUp, sum(feedback_down) AS fbDown, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abandoned) AS abandoned, count(*) FILTER (WHERE safety_blocked_count > 0) AS safety, count(*) FILTER (WHERE unauthorized_attempt_count > 0) AS unauthorized, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sensitive_output_hits > 0) AS sensitive FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to}

SELECT termination_reason AS key, count(*) AS count FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to}
GROUP BY termination_reason

SELECT percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p99 FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to} AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT tool_name AS toolName, sum(call_count) AS calls, sum(failed_count) AS failed, sum(total_duration_ms) AS totalMs, max(max_duration_ms) AS maxMs FROM platform.agent_trace_tool_call WHERE started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to}
GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC, tool_name LIMIT 50

SELECT trace_id AS traceId, started_at AS startedAt, tool_rounds AS toolRounds, loop_suspected_count AS loopSuspectedCount, coalesce(input_tokens,0) + coalesce(output_tokens,0) AS totalTokens FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to} AND (coalesce(input_tokens,0) + coalesce(output_tokens,0) > 20000 OR loop_suspected_count > 0 OR max_rounds_reached)
ORDER BY (coalesce(input_tokens,0) + coalesce(output_tokens,0)) DESC, started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT scenario AS key, count(*) AS count FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND agent_version = #{agentVersion} GROUP BY scenario

SELECT trace_id AS traceId, tenant_id::text AS tenantId, run_id::text AS runId, scenario, auto_checked AS autoChecked, auto_verified AS autoVerified, max_rounds_reached AS maxRoundsReached, loop_suspected_count AS loopSuspectedCount, safety_blocked_count AS safetyBlockedCount, coalesce(input_tokens,0) + coalesce(output_tokens,0) AS totalTokens, started_at AS startedAt FROM platform.agent_trace_metric WHERE started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to} AND sampled IS NOT TRUE
ORDER BY CASE WHEN loop_suspected_count > 0 OR max_rounds_reached OR coalesce(safety_blocked_count, 0) > 0 OR coalesce(input_tokens,0) + coalesce(output_tokens,0) > 20000 THEN 0 WHEN auto_checked IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
